[[Kkraz's Indulgence]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Doomed Ancient Kkraz]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Raisu Palace]] and [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Soul Reaping]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +10 (vs. [[Slashing damage]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jug]] [[dye|dyed]] blue.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "The Riddle of Steel" and "Forget Me Not".
